description: The configuration of a Papyrus project, for the papyrus toolchain.

compiler.description: PapyrusCompiler.exe, or Caprica. By default, the Creation Kit's of a default Steam installation.

output.description: Where the .pex files go, relative to this file. Scripts by default.

flags.description: A .flg file replacing the game's vanilla flags, relative to this file.

indent.description: 1 to 8 spaces, or "tab". 2 spaces by default.

keywords.description: The case of keywords: "lower", `endfunction`, by default, or "pascal", `EndFunction`, as the Creation Kit writes them.

game.description: The target game. Without it, it is inferred from the scripts.

imports.description: Folders of scripts the project builds on — a library, another mod, the game's sources — read but never checked, relative to this file.

include-fragments.description: Check the fragments generated by the Creation Kit too.

lints.description: The level of each lint, by name or by code.

PAP001.description: string or docstring the target's compiler will silently corrupt (PAP001, warn by default)

PAP002.description: flag the game's .flg file does not allow on this object (PAP002, error by default)

PAP003.description: unknown lint name in `; papyrus: allow(...)`, which therefore suppresses nothing (PAP003, warn by default)

PAP004.description: event the script never receives, most often a typo (PAP004, warn by default)

PAP005.description: call with too few or too many arguments (PAP005, error by default)

PAP006.description: named argument the callee does not declare, or already given (PAP006, warn by default)

PAP007.description: argument, assignment or return value of a type the compiler does not cast implicitly; cast, comparison or arithmetic between unrelated types; the value of a call that returns nothing (PAP007, error by default)

PAP008.description: function, variable, property or field that does not exist, most often a typo (PAP008, error by default)

PAP009.description: typed function that can reach its end without `Return`, and return the default value (PAP009, warn by default)

PAP010.description: `GotoState` to a state the script does not declare, which behaves as the empty state (PAP010, error by default)

PAP011.description: event whose parameters differ from the event it implements (PAP011, error by default)

PAP012.description: assignment to an `AutoReadOnly` or `Const` property, or one without `Set` (PAP012, error by default)

PAP013.description: non-`Global` function called on its script, or `self` and members used in a `Global` function (PAP013, error by default)

PAP014.description: statements after one that always returns, which never run (PAP014, warn by default)

PAP015.description: local variable never read (PAP015, warn by default)

PAP016.description: parameter never read, after the last one read; events and overrides excepted (PAP016, warn by default)

PAP017.description: member or script only SKSE declares, in a Skyrim project that does not use SKSE (PAP017, warn by default)

PAP018.description: script that does not exist, once the game's sources are in the project or its imports (PAP018, error by default)

PAP019.description: local declared twice in a block, named like a parameter or a script variable, or hiding one of an enclosing block (PAP019, error by default)

PAP020.description: name written with another case than its declaration, which the compiler ignores (PAP020, warn by default)

PAP021.description: `ScriptName` other than the name of the file, which the compiler refuses (PAP021, error by default)

PAP022.description: script that extends itself, directly or through its ancestors (PAP022, error by default)

PAP023.description: function or event declared twice in a state, variable or property declared twice, a second `Auto` state; from Fallout 4, a property named like a variable (PAP023, error by default)

PAP024.description: `Return value` in a function without return type or in an event, `Return` alone in a typed function (PAP024, error by default)

PAP025.description: function whose parameters, defaults or return type differ from the parent's or the empty state's; a `Global` function redefined; from Fallout 4, a function named like an event; in Starfield, a native function overridden (PAP025, error by default)

PAP026.description: function in a state that neither the empty state nor an ancestor declares, a `Global` function in a state (PAP026, error by default)

PAP027.description: `Get` or `Set` of the wrong shape, another function in a property, an initial value on a full property, `AutoReadOnly` without one (PAP027, error by default)

PAP028.description: `new T[n]` beyond 128 elements; in Skyrim, of a size that is not a literal from 1 to 128 (PAP028, error by default)

PAP029.description: assignment to a call, to `.Length` or to anything but a variable, a property or an array element (PAP029, error by default)

PAP030.description: initial value of a script variable or a property, or default of a parameter, that is not a literal (PAP030, error by default)

PAP031.description: from Fallout 4, a parameter without default after one with a default (PAP031, error by default)

PAP032.description: from Fallout 4, a `Native` function in a script that is not `Native` (PAP032, error by default)

PAP033.description: integer literal that does not fit 32 bits; from Fallout 4, a decimal one above 2147483647 (PAP033, error by default)

PAP034.description: `RegisterForUpdate` or `RegisterForUpdateGameTime`, which keep firing in saves after the mod is removed: prefer their `Single` versions (PAP034, warn by default)

PAP035.description: `Game.GetPlayer()` called on each iteration of a loop (PAP035, warn by default)

PAP036.description: boolean compared with `True` or `False` (PAP036, warn by default)

PAP037.description: variable, property or element assigned to itself (PAP037, warn by default)

PAP038.description: value compared with itself, always the same answer (PAP038, warn by default)

PAP039.description: script variable never read; `Conditional` ones excepted, which the game's conditions read (PAP039, warn by default)

PAP040.description: `Import` of a script none of whose global functions or types the script uses (PAP040, warn by default)

PAP041.description: function that comes back to itself on every path, directly or through others, and never returns (PAP041, warn by default)

PAP101.description: locals and parameters in lowerCamelCase (PAP101, warn by default)

PAP102.description: script variables, properties and struct fields in lowerCamelCase (PAP102, warn by default)

PAP103.description: functions, events, states, structs and groups in PascalCase (PAP103, warn by default)

allow/unknown.description: unknown lint name in `; papyrus: allow(...)`, which therefore suppresses nothing (PAP003, warn by default)

arrays/size.description: `new T[n]` beyond 128 elements; in Skyrim, of a size that is not a literal from 1 to 128 (PAP028, error by default)

bools/comparison.description: boolean compared with `True` or `False` (PAP036, warn by default)

calls/arity.description: call with too few or too many arguments (PAP005, error by default)

calls/get-player.description: `Game.GetPlayer()` called on each iteration of a loop (PAP035, warn by default)

calls/infinite-recursion.description: function that comes back to itself on every path, directly or through others, and never returns (PAP041, warn by default)

calls/named-arg.description: named argument the callee does not declare, or already given (PAP006, warn by default)

calls/not-global.description: non-`Global` function called on its script, or `self` and members used in a `Global` function (PAP013, error by default)

code/not-assignable.description: assignment to a call, to `.Length` or to anything but a variable, a property or an array element (PAP029, error by default)

code/self-assign.description: variable, property or element assigned to itself (PAP037, warn by default)

code/self-compare.description: value compared with itself, always the same answer (PAP038, warn by default)

code/unreachable.description: statements after one that always returns, which never run (PAP014, warn by default)

encoding/lossy.description: string or docstring the target's compiler will silently corrupt (PAP001, warn by default)

events/signature.description: event whose parameters differ from the event it implements (PAP011, error by default)

events/unknown.description: event the script never receives, most often a typo (PAP004, warn by default)

flags/placement.description: flag the game's .flg file does not allow on this object (PAP002, error by default)

functions/native.description: from Fallout 4, a `Native` function in a script that is not `Native` (PAP032, error by default)

imports/unused.description: `Import` of a script none of whose global functions or types the script uses (PAP040, warn by default)

literals/int-range.description: integer literal that does not fit 32 bits; from Fallout 4, a decimal one above 2147483647 (PAP033, error by default)

locals/duplicate.description: local declared twice in a block, named like a parameter or a script variable, or hiding one of an enclosing block (PAP019, error by default)

locals/unused.description: local variable never read (PAP015, warn by default)

members/duplicate.description: function or event declared twice in a state, variable or property declared twice, a second `Auto` state; from Fallout 4, a property named like a variable (PAP023, error by default)

members/skse.description: member or script only SKSE declares, in a Skyrim project that does not use SKSE (PAP017, warn by default)

members/unknown.description: function, variable, property or field that does not exist, most often a typo (PAP008, error by default)

names/case.description: name written with another case than its declaration, which the compiler ignores (PAP020, warn by default)

naming/functions.description: functions, events, states, structs and groups in PascalCase (PAP103, warn by default)

naming/locals.description: locals and parameters in lowerCamelCase (PAP101, warn by default)

naming/variables.description: script variables, properties and struct fields in lowerCamelCase (PAP102, warn by default)

overrides/signature.description: function whose parameters, defaults or return type differ from the parent's or the empty state's; a `Global` function redefined; from Fallout 4, a function named like an event; in Starfield, a native function overridden (PAP025, error by default)

params/default-order.description: from Fallout 4, a parameter without default after one with a default (PAP031, error by default)

params/unused.description: parameter never read, after the last one read; events and overrides excepted (PAP016, warn by default)

properties/accessors.description: `Get` or `Set` of the wrong shape, another function in a property, an initial value on a full property, `AutoReadOnly` without one (PAP027, error by default)

properties/readonly.description: assignment to an `AutoReadOnly` or `Const` property, or one without `Set` (PAP012, error by default)

returns/missing.description: typed function that can reach its end without `Return`, and return the default value (PAP009, warn by default)

returns/value.description: `Return value` in a function without return type or in an event, `Return` alone in a typed function (PAP024, error by default)

scripts/cycle.description: script that extends itself, directly or through its ancestors (PAP022, error by default)

scripts/name.description: `ScriptName` other than the name of the file, which the compiler refuses (PAP021, error by default)

scripts/unknown.description: script that does not exist, once the game's sources are in the project or its imports (PAP018, error by default)

states/function.description: function in a state that neither the empty state nor an ancestor declares, a `Global` function in a state (PAP026, error by default)

states/unknown.description: `GotoState` to a state the script does not declare, which behaves as the empty state (PAP010, error by default)

types/mismatch.description: argument, assignment or return value of a type the compiler does not cast implicitly; cast, comparison or arithmetic between unrelated types; the value of a call that returns nothing (PAP007, error by default)

updates/repeating.description: `RegisterForUpdate` or `RegisterForUpdateGameTime`, which keep firing in saves after the mod is removed: prefer their `Single` versions (PAP034, warn by default)

values/not-literal.description: initial value of a script variable or a property, or default of a parameter, that is not a literal (PAP030, error by default)

variables/unused.description: script variable never read; `Conditional` ones excepted, which the game's conditions read (PAP039, warn by default)

skse.description: Skyrim with SKSE installed: its functions and scripts are known.
